description: This Kotlin source file defines a `SearchFragment` class for an Android app, providing voice and text search functionality for workout items. It manages UI components, handles user interactions, and integrates with repositories and activities for searching and playing workout videos.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that provides voice and text search functionalities for workouts, rendering results with a Leanback grid and enabling playback via a separate activity.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, sets up search UI, adapters, and voice recognition.

methods.name: launchPlayer
methods.description: Starts the PlayerActivity to play the selected workout.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of voice recognition, fills the search field, and triggers a search.
